about.p1: Firma Textile is a new venture built on a textile career that began in the 1980s. The company prepares print and plain dye collections in fabrics made from sustainable, high-density and high-twist yarns, and delivers them to international markets. Behind it are professionals who know their work.

collections.heading: A selected group from our SS27 collection.
collections.sub: Printed and tonal qualities, prepared with our partner mills on high twist, high density yarns.
collections.micro: Full collection & colourways sent on request

categories.title: Floral
categories.blurb: Botanical drawing at every scale, from a fine sprig to an overscale bloom. The register that carries the summer dress.

categories.title: Geometric
categories.blurb: Hand drawn geometry, redrawn from Anatolian flatweave and tile. Structure without stiffness.

categories.title: Classic
categories.blurb: The two colour archive repeat. Small, disciplined, and reordered season after season.

categories.title: Stripes
categories.blurb: Irregular and drawn by hand rather than generated. Warm through cool across five widths.

categories.title: Tonal
categories.blurb: Ground on ground, where the cloth itself is the subject and the high twist construction does the work.
